exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to hold, to keep, to support
to support, to back, to second, to uphold
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: держа́ть — to hold, to keep, to support; держа́ться — to hold on; содержа́ние — keeping; подде́рживать — to support, to back, to second, to uphold.
**задержали** — задержа́ть (perfective): to hold up, detain, to hold back, to stop; to delay, to check; to arrest, to detain; to slow down, to retard, to delay, to hamper. Wiktionary: за- + держа́ть.

exercises.why: From Wiktionary: поддержа́ть — to support, to back up, to second; подде́ржка — support (financial or other help); держа́ва — state, power (a powerful country); приде́рживаться — to hold (to), to keep (to).

**выдерживаю** — выде́рживать (imperfective): to stand, to withstand, to bear, to sustain, to endure; to pass exam; to contain oneself, to control oneself; to maintain, to keep up, to observe. Wiktionary: вы́держать + -ивать.
